findings.claim: Codex review could display user-owned fields inside model_providers.vercel tables despite the managed-fields-only promise.
findings.evidence: The initial snapshot copied every line in the Vercel tables. It was replaced with exact field whitelists and a regression test proving private_token and custom_secret never appear.

findings.evidence: 0.8.1 documents code added-lines and removed-lines with Geist washes and renderer-owned markers; Gateway Spend carries a 2355-line 0.7.1 SDK patch that does not migrate cleanly in this feature.
